title: सुरक्षा र विकासः एक रथका दुई पाङ्ग्रा Surakshya ra Bikas Ek Rathka Dui Pangra
nepali: शान्ति, सुरक्षा र विकासका सम्बन्धमा विश्वको पहिलोजननी नेपाल हो । नेपालको स्वतन्त्रता, सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता, स्वाधीनता र राष्ट्रिय एकताकोरक्षाका लागि संविधानप्रति प्रतिबद्ध समावेशी नेपालीसेनाको एक संगठन रहने र नेपाल सरकारले नेपालीसेनालाई संघीय कानुनबमोजिम विकास निर्माण र विपद् व्यवस्थापन लगायतका अन्य कार्यमा समेत परिचालनगर्न सक्ने संवैधानिक र कानुनी प्रावधान रहेको छ । सेनालाई विकास–निर्माणको काममा लगाउ“दा पेशागतदक्षतामा कत्ति पनि असर पर्दैन । राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा दर्बिलो भएन भने विकास–निर्माणले गति लिन सक्दैन ।
american_english: Nepal is the world's first nation when it comes to peace, security and development. For the protection of Nepal's independence, sovereignty, territorial integrity, freedom and national unity, there is a constitutional and legal provision that one inclusive organization of the Nepal Army, committed to the constitution, shall remain, and that the Government of Nepal may mobilize the Nepal Army for development and construction, disaster management and other tasks as well, in accordance with federal law. Deploying the army in development and construction work does not affect its professional competence in any way. If national security is not strong, development and construction cannot gain momentum.
british_english: Nepal is the world's first nation in matters of peace, security and development. For the protection of Nepal's independence, sovereignty, territorial integrity, freedom and national unity, there is a constitutional and legal provision for one inclusive organisation of the Nepal Army, committed to the constitution, to remain, and for the Government of Nepal to be able to mobilise the Nepal Army for development and construction, disaster management and other tasks too, in accordance with federal law. Employing the army in development and construction work does not affect its professional competence at all. If national security is not robust, development and construction cannot gather pace.
australian_english: Nepal is the world's first country when it comes to peace, security and development. To protect Nepal's independence, sovereignty, territorial integrity, freedom and national unity, there's a constitutional and legal provision that one inclusive organisation of the Nepal Army, committed to the constitution, will remain, and that the Government of Nepal can mobilise the Nepal Army for development and construction, disaster management and other jobs as well, under federal law. Putting the army onto development and construction work doesn't dent its professional competence one bit. If national security isn't strong, development and construction can't get moving.
informal_english: Apparently Nepal's the world's first when it comes to peace, security and development. The constitution keeps one inclusive Nepal Army unit, loyal to the constitution, around to protect Nepal's independence, sovereignty, territory, freedom and national unity, and the government can call the army in for development and construction, disaster management and other stuff under federal law. Putting the army on building jobs doesn't knock its professional skills at all. And if national security's weak, development and construction just can't get going.
